reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the existing daily-skip filter in getNextDate. However, getDatesInRange writes its own holiday check instead of using the new predicate.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test is defined in isNonWorkingDay, and then restated inline in getDatesInRange as `d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date))`.

placement.why: The non-working-day rule and the moving loop sit in shared/schedules.ts. Because the predicate is kept module-private, the server handler cannot use it and copies it instead.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but it reformats the whole getDatesInRange expression and one unrelated occurrences call.

maintainability.why: The next change to what counts as a non-working day (the MM-DD holidays the following step asks for) has to be made both in isNonWorkingDay and in the inline copy in app.ts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange re-implements isNonWorkingDay inline instead of calling it.

disguised_duplication.where: The getDatesInRange condition restates isNonWorkingDay with different syntax (optional chaining on config.holidays, dayFromDate from monthUtils).

one_place.where: The weekend-or-holiday rule lives in shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay (used by getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend) and again inline in server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange.
